title: Nice planter
text: Nice planter. I only gave this a 4 star for sturdiness because it is a dry uncoated cement planter and think that it might crumble if you drop it..but maybe it wont. It is fairly lightweight for cement but it has a nice weight as it wont be easy to tip. If you like the rustic natural look like I do, then you will like this grey coloring planter. It comes with a plastic drip tray which is just the right size..not too big to take up more space. Good size pot. If you want to you can paint it.
